chitchat: torques a bolt on the reload hoist and spits into the dirt.
"Bird takes a bite out of the nest, I stitch her up before the smoke clears. Toll never stops."
description: A Redline armourer down among the missile racks and the reload hoist, grease to the shoulder and a red rag knotted at his throat. He keeps the nest fed and, when a strafing run guts the rail, welds it back together.

bye.text: They turn back to the racks.

root.text: They don't look up from the hoist. "The nest stays hot because I keep it hot. You're not helping — you're in my light. Move."

name: a Redline armourer
